recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if a later work-group decision explicitly changes ImagingStudy.series.modality cardinality or supersedes the modality naming decision.
issue_request: FHIR-12477 asked to make ImagingStudy.series.modality optional so ImagingStudy could be used in place of ImagingManifest. The Published / Not Persuasive with Modification resolution rejected changing series.modality cardinality and approved renaming top-level modalityList to modality.
initial_application: Historical commit 7b2b64512052c9a800a59b0ac3cd2cd013659b1b explicitly mentions GF#12477 in a bundled ImagingStudy update and changed the historical spreadsheet from ImagingStudy.modalityList to ImagingStudy.modality. Current source and fhir.ini show that application is already present.
additional_context: ImagingStudy is active in source/fhir.ini. Current StructureDefinition source has ImagingStudy.modality as a 0..* top-level element and ImagingStudy.series.modality as 1..1. The ImagingStudy modality search parameter continues to target ImagingStudy.series.modality. Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant or conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because making series.modality optional would contradict the final issue decision, and the approved rename is already represented in active source.
